The second pathway connects staurosporine to Transmembrane glycoprotein NMB, which is targeted by flavopiridol, also targeting Nek1. Both pathways involve staurosporine as a modulator of a protein that ultimately interacts with Nek1. The scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, with similar final scores in both cases. The mechanisms involve staurosporine acting as a modulator of signaling pathways that lead to the activation of Nek1. While the evidence is consistent, the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct relationship between staurosporine and Nek1.
